events.title: European Shares Seen Higher At Open As Oil Prices Retreat
events.description: European stocks are seen opening broadly higher on Monday as oil prices retreated and focus shifted to several key central bank decisions, including the U.S. Federal Reserve's latest monetary policy meeting later in the week.

events.title: Indian Shares Open Lower In Cautious Trade
events.description: Indian shares were moving lower in early trade on Monday amid renewed concerns over elevated oil prices and caution ahead of the U.S. Federal Reserve's interest-rate decision, due later in the week.

events.title: Australian Market Swings To Slight Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian stock market is swinging its slight gains in mid-market trading on Monday after opening in the red, extending the slight gains in the previous session, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street on Friday. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is moving above the 8,800.00 level, with gains in mining and technology stocks partially offset by weakness in financial stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Track Wall Street Lower
events.description: Asian stock markets are trading mostly lower on Monday, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street on Friday, on rising oil prices and global inflation worries amid uncertainty in the Middle East conflict. Traders also remain cautious ahead of the interest rate decision this week from the central banks in the US, Japan and the Eurozone. Asian markets closed mixed on Friday.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Opening On Muted Note
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening on a muted note on Monday as investors closely monitor the situation in the Middle East and await an upcoming Federal Reserve interest-rate decision.

events.title: Lower Open Tipped For Thai Stock Market
events.description: Ahead of Friday's holiday for King Chulalongkorn Memorial Day, the Thai stock market has moved higher in back-to-back sessions, climbing more than 7 points or 0.4 percent in that span. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,560-point plateau although it may tick lower on Monday.

events.title: Japanese Market Notably Lower
events.description: The Japanese stock market is notably lower on Monday, extending the losses in the previous two sessions, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street on Friday. The Nikkei 225 is falling below the 62,450 level, with weakness is index heavyweights and technology stocks partially offset by gains in financial stocks.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market May Run Out Of Steam On Monday
events.description: The Indonesia stock market has finished higher in four straight sessions, adding almost 450 points or 8.6 percent in that span. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just beneath the 5,440-point plateau although the rally may stall on Monday.

events.title: Australian Markets Modestly Lower
events.description: The Australian stock market is modestly lower on Monday, reversing the slight gains in the previous session, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street on Friday. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is falling well below the 8,800.00 level, with weakness in financial stocks partially offset by gains in mining and technology stocks.

events.title: Soft Start Tipped For Hong Kong Stock Market
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market on Friday wrote a finish to the three-day losing streak in which it had stumbled more than 1,450 points or 4.3 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just below the 23,100-point plateau although it may open under pressure on Monday.

events.title: Renewed Consolidation Predicted For China Stock Market
events.description: The China stock market on Friday snapped the two-day slide in which it had dropped more than 75 points or 2.1 percent. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,690-point plateau although it's looking at a soft start on Monday.

events.title: Singapore Stock Market Expected To Remain Rangebound
events.description: The Singapore stock market has opened higher in two of three trading days since the end of the two-day losing streak in which it had dipped more than 10 points or 0.2 percent. The STI now sits just above the 5,420-point plateau although it's likely to open under water on Monday.

events.title: Malaysia Stock Market May Spin Its Wheels On Monday
events.description: The Malaysia stock market has finished higher in four straight sessions, collecting almost 15 points or 0.9 percent in that span. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just above the 1,610-point plateau although it may run out of steam on Monday.
